PR 3 · search autocomplete · same index as the Related block

Typeahead that works with the network off

The generated index carries page titles plus headings for all 313 docs pages. The matcher is deterministic: tiered prefix scoring, then a 1-edit fuzzy pass on 4+ char queries, then a stable tiebreak. Arrow keys, Enter and Escape come from the fumadocs list; the combobox exposes aria-activedescendant.

Jev rerank of the top 10 is flag-gated (ORK_SITE_JEV_RERANK, off in production) with a 150 ms per-keystroke budget and a silent deterministic fallback. This playground embeds a 28-entry slice of the real index and simulates the two rerank modes locally: nothing here touches the network. The Jev bar stands in for the ~40 ms System One call; the LLM bar stands in for a full chat-model rerank.

Try it

suggest rerank: p50 0ms · p95 0ms · 0 req · ~$0.0000

↑/↓ moves, Enter selects, Esc clears. Jev and LLM modes apply a simulated rerank after a simulated call, then record latency and estimated cost below. Switch to Jev off and the same suggestions appear instantly, every keystroke, no waiting.
